improvement_actions_for_57.description: results/manifest_fix_patch.txt was written in Exp 731 (manifest_fix_written=true) but the patch has not been applied to scripts/research_conductor.py. This is a MANDATORY human action item for .57 pre-flight. Until applied, the exclusion manifest check exists as a file but is not enforced at conductor dequeue time. Legacy experiments (425, 410, 383, 380-382) will re-run in .57 if this is not resolved.

FR-11 relay confirmed fully_operational (Exp 734 relay_operational=true, Exp 738 tier2_relay_functional=true). Update _bmad/traceability.md and openspec/capabilities/*/spec.md to mark FR-11 as OPERATIONAL. This is the first milestone where FR-11 has been end-to-end verified.

Exps 729 and 730 blocked for second consecutive cycle on an unresolved upstream dependency. Identify and resolve the blocking dependency before .57 queues these experiments. If dependency cannot be resolved in .57 planning, redesign privacy filter v1 to remove the dependency or retire both experiments.

Per .55 retro protocol: VR RETRO-033 closed on first positive result (Exp 720, signed_improvement=0.00510). Marginal improvement (0.51%) requires a second 200q trial in .57 with a different random seed. If positive again, RETRO-033 is definitively closed. If negative, re-open and treat .55 as a false positive.

Governance rule: experiments >45 min for 3+ consecutive milestones must be retired. Exp 627 (416 min), Exp 441 (93 min), Exp 482 (75 min) are all above threshold. Verify carry count for each in .56 and .55 retros. If carry count >= 3, add to exclusion manifest before .57 dequeue. Exp 690 (52 min, partial) is in its second consecutive appearance — optimization or retirement required per second-appearance protocol.

PSV root cause confirmed as constraint specialization (Exp 736) and recovery confirmed (Exp 737). Continue domain-diverse training in .57. Monitor condition_b and condition_c slopes across next 2 milestones. If slopes reverse again, escalate to architecture review.

Conductor-vs-actual wall time gap has persisted since .52. The .56 cycle is too small for this to matter, but at full scale the gap is the primary retro finding. Add a structured timing JSON entry at the conductor's actual experiment dispatch site (not planning site) to enable automated full-milestone retro construction. This is a code change in scripts/research_conductor.py (pending manifest patch application).
